description: R08 Host ScreenBuffer terminal-scrolling alternate checkpoint: safe Rust owns restore-down viewport anchoring, cursor snap and active-buffer API targeting while preserving main state.

entries.notes: Safe Rust keeps the terminal-scrolling alternate viewport anchored at top zero and realigns virtual bottom to the active viewport through maximize and restore-down resizing.
Safe Rust distinguishes output viewport movement from mouse scrollback, preserves virtual bottom during manual scrollback and snaps the viewport to API cursor positioning under terminal scrolling.
Console clear and cursor-position API effects are routed to the active alternate even through main ownership, while main text and cursor state remain untouched.
